about_the_game:
Explore, build, and survive on an island full of secrets.

In this fantasy sandbox, you’ll arrive on a mysterious island—alone or with up to 3 friends. Face escalating challenges, grow your own resources, and uncover ancient secrets hidden among ruins, forests, and mountains.

· Building and survival: Construct your shelter, grow crops with a water-based system, upgrade your weapons by combining unique gems, and prepare what you need to survive.

· Exploration: Roam a land full of secrets, alternate paths, and hidden treasures. You never know when danger might strike.

· Co-op mode: Play online with up to 3 friends. Divide tasks, share resources, and face the island’s dangers together.

· Retro style: Graphics inspired by the classic Mode 7, blending simulated 3D depth with 2D pixel art elements.

The world is full of resources, combinations, and countless paths to follow. Whether you build a peaceful home or challenge the island’s darkest secrets, how you live this adventure is up to you.
